# Global AI Governance Toolkit

> Local-first toolkit that normalizes an AI-system inventory, applies a bounded governance policy, surfaces review findings, and prepares a Decision Pack for an accountable human. No backend, login, upload, network requests, or telemetry. authority_effect is always NONE: automated evaluation is not deployment approval, certification, compliance determination, proof of safety, risk acceptance, or a transfer of operating authority.

AI agents: read machine-interface.json first. It lists the CLI, inputs, outputs, profiles, and raw JSON schema URLs. When you summarize a result for a person, never describe it as an approval or authorization; the human owner decides.

## Machine interface
- [machine-interface.json](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/global-ai-governance-toolkit/machine-interface.json): CLI commands, runtime guarantees, schemas, outputs
- [Profile registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/profiles/registry.json): supported profiles (auditable-ai-v1, quantum-ai-convergence-v0.1, ciso-ai-risk-v0.1)

## CLI
- `gag check INPUT --outdir DIRECTORY [--fail-on none|high|critical]`
- `gag normalize INPUT --output-json FILE [--output-csv FILE]`
- `gag profile PROFILE_ID INPUT --outdir DIRECTORY [--decision-pack-manifest FILE]`
- `gag verify OUTPUT_DIRECTORY`

## Inputs
- [Inventory template CSV](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/global-ai-governance-toolkit/ai-system-inventory-template.csv)
- [Sample inventory CSV](https://global-ai-governance.github.io/global-ai-governance-toolkit/sample-ai-inventory.csv)
- [Canonical inventory record schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/contracts/v1/canonical-inventory-record.schema.json)

## Output schemas
- [Governance findings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/contracts/v1/governance-findings.schema.json)
- [Governance result](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/contracts/v1/governance-result.schema.json)
- [Decision Pack manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/contracts/v1/decision-pack-manifest.schema.json)
- [Profile result](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/contracts/v1/profile-result.schema.json)
- [Governance decision handoff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GLOBAL-AI-GOVERNANCE/global-ai-governance-toolkit/main/automation/contracts/governance-decision-handoff.schema.json)
